messages:
lin: Quick note 1: we had another customer-facing surprise where Console showed a successful feature toggle flip but ~30% of edge agents kept the old value. users saw routing weight mismatch and a cost blip.
ada: ouch. Any apply_id / logs?
lin: apply_id=ap-74512. control-plane returned 200, then agents logs show `reject: operator_lock` for some nodes. No visible banner in Console.
ops-bot: apply ap-74512 recorded at 2026-05-02T08:04:12Z (status=accepted_control_plane)
tony: we need three things immediately: (1) an "apply visibility" mode where Console shows per-agent ack counts and rejects, (2) an opt-in `quorum` apply mode (k-of-n) for teams that want stronger guarantees, (3) a no-op dry-run that proves agent acceptance without changing runtime state.
ada: API sketch: `POST /admin/configs/apply?mode=quorum&quorum=3` returns `escrow_token`. Client can poll `GET /admin/applies/{escrow_token}/status` for ack counts.
lin: Console UX: show a compact banner "Apply pending (2/5 agents)" with a dropdown listing agent ids and reject reasons. Also provide a "resume apply" button to retry failed agents.
tony: telemetry: emit `config.apply.event` for each ack/reject with fields `apply_id`, `agent_id`, `status`, `reason`. Add a dashboard panel that shows `apply_lag_ms` and `drift_pct` per-tenant.
ada: rollout plan: implement fast path default unchanged; add quorum path behind a runtime flag; wire Console to show pending applies; add alert if `drift_pct > 0.2%` for >5m.
lin: security note: escrow tokens and audit must mask secret-like fields. No secrets in logs.
ops-bot: runbook stub created: "If apply stuck: check agent versions, operator locks, run reconcile job POST /admin/reconcile?apply=ap-74512"
tony: i'll sketch API PR and Console mock today. ada, can you add telemetry events and the drift metric?
ada: yes ETA 2d for metrics + alerts.
lin: thanks team. getting per-agent visibility will stop a lot of silent partial-rollouts.
